review_log.summary: All four required sections present and accessibility/competitor work is strong, but Pilates (half of workout differentiator #2 in docs/idea.md) is entirely absent, in-workout session execution conventions are missing, and portion-entry conventions for African prepared dishes are unaddressed. See pipeline/review-log.md for the actionable fix list.

All five required sections present; nutrition-side research, market prioritization (Nigeria+Ghana+Kenya), data sourcing, and unified-vs-module recommendation are strong and honest. Rejected because the workout side contradicts docs/idea.md: calisthenics and Pilates appear nowhere, and the bodyweight skill-tree concept is reframed as gym/weights progressive overload (Fitbod/JEFIT competitors, sets/reps/weight requirements). Micronutrient tracking (explicit idea requirement) is missing from Core Feature Requirements, and the idea's open question on validated progression trees is dropped. See pipeline/review-log.md for the actionable fix list.

All four first-pass fixes verified done (Pilates audit via Alo Moves/5 Minute Pilates/NTC, in-workout execution conventions for both modes, household-unit portion-entry note, updated warm/clean-hybrid direction with tonal flex). Rejected because reviewed-and-approved content was silently removed against the explicit preserve-as-is instruction: the gamification quadrant (Duolingo, Habitica) is gone, the named African-brand reference (Flutterwave) was stripped to an unnamed generic, YAZIO was silently swapped for Noom, and the scope note falsely claims those quadrants are 'preserved as reviewed.' Narrow fix list in pipeline/review-log.md; the four new additions are approved as-is and must not change.

All five first-pass fixes verified done: workout module correctly reframed as bodyweight-only calisthenics + Pilates skill tree with objective time-hold/rep-threshold mastery gates and gym/external-load explicitly out of scope; on-category competitors added with sourced complaints (Calistree, Calisthenics Mastery, Thenx, Freeletics as self-rated-gating analogue, Pilatesology/Pilates Anytime); micronutrient tracking is now Core Feature Requirement 4 with named nutrients and FCT-coverage caveats; the progression-tree validation open question is carried forward as explicitly unresolved with an owner type and timing; stale brief-based disclaimer removed. Preservation explicitly verified against the research-design pass-2 failure mode: diaspora persona with dual-cuisine scope-multiplier insight, full Nigeria+Ghana+Kenya priority-markets rationale (shared WAFCT, Kenya FCT 2018, SA/Ethiopia held for v2), and full unified-app-vs-two-modules rationale are all intact at full depth. Sitemap stage unblocked; it must treat progression-tree validation (Open Question 1) as unresolved.

Structure is largely right: 11 of 13 Core Feature Requirements trace fully to real screens, Req 13 is honestly flagged as a cross-cutting engineering constraint, Open Question 1 discipline is correct (placeholder [Skill Node] names, TBD thresholds, no invented progression content), the unified one-app/two-modules structure with shared account/Home/Progress layers is correct, and the three requirement-less screens are all justified. Rejected on two concrete traceability failures: (1) Req 1's portion-photo reference set — which the research calls 'the entry-point that mainstream apps fail' — appears nowhere in the sitemap, yet traceability row 1 claims full coverage without a flag; (2) Req 9's placement assessment is structurally calisthenics-only (singular 'Starting Tier Placement', push/pull/squat-hinge/core-hold steps) with no per-track Pilates placement, reproducing the documented 'I don't know where to start' Pilates-incumbent failure. Narrow two-item fix list in pipeline/review-log.md; everything else is explicitly approved as-is and must not be thinned.
